caption:
Swipe to steal 7 Grok prompts that read live X conversation to find crypto moves before the chart shows them. 🔍

Prompt 1 scans live X sentiment on any coin and rates it 1 to 10, Prompt 2 finds the 10 most-followed crypto influencers who just changed their mind on a coin, Prompt 3 catches the moment a coin's narrative shifts before the chart does, Prompt 4 hunts projects gaining fast X noise before they trend, Prompt 5 separates FUD from verified fact on any current negative claim, Prompt 6 tracks whale wallet discussion on X and builds a bull and bear case, Prompt 7 turns everything X is saying into your own entry and exit timing plan.

Every trader looks at the same charts. Grok reads what the actual buyers and sellers are saying on X in real time, often hours before price moves. That gap is where early positions get built.
